objective: Strategie de Mean-reversion sur PLUMEUSDC 1w. Indicateurs : Bollinger Bands(20,2), ATR. Entree long quand prix rebondit depuis bande inferieure vers bande mediane. Sortie a la bande mediane. Stop-loss = 1.5x ATR, take-profit = 3.0x ATR.

iterations.hypothesis: Mean-reversion strategy using Bollinger Bands to identify overextended price levels, with ATR for dynamic risk management. When price bounces from the lower band toward the middle band, it suggests a temporary reversal in momentum, offering a high-probability entry point. ATR-based stops ensure proper risk-adjusted positioning.

Adding RSI as a momentum filter improves mean-reversion signals by confirming overbought/oversold conditions before entering trades, reducing whipsaw in choppy markets while maintaining ATR-based risk management for consistent profit targets.
